Basic rules for desk cover on the job
Trainers ask staff to read this twice, and this page helps new colleagues see why

This page explains the care and order expected at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, because small mistakes can unsettle travelers and animals alike. When you cover the desk, keep your tone calm, your notes clear, and your handoffs clean. Use plain language, stay polite, and make sure each traveler feels listened to without delay or pressure.

At the desk, you will gather the details needed for safe movement, confirm carrier condition, and pass information to the right team without adding extra remarks. <<FACT F102>> If an animal is due to move between services, stay with the approved process and keep the record complete before anything is transferred. <<FACT F088>> Do not improvise, because a rushed reply can create confusion for the cabin team and the ground team alike.

When a traveler speaks about concern, answer with care and keep the focus on practical next steps. If a carrier looks unsafe, if a document is missing, or if the animal seems distressed, pause and escalate at once through the normal channel. Never promise what you cannot confirm, and never guess at a rule. A short and accurate explanation is better than a long and uncertain one.

Keep your workspace tidy, protect personal details, and check that each note matches the service file before you move on. If you must hand over to another colleague, leave a clear trail so the next person does not have to repeat the work. What to remember is simple: be calm, be precise, and keep every companion safe through careful desk cover.
